title: Gender-Based Violence in 140 Characters or Fewer: A #BigData Case Study of Twitter
reasoning: The paper focuses on the computational social science approach to monitoring public attitude and awareness regarding gender-based violence (GBV) through Twitter. While GBV is a topic with strong moral and ethical implications, the study focuses on data collection, volume analysis, and sentiment/thematic categorization rather than benchmarking religion, faith, or formal ethical frameworks.
